name: Habakkuk
title: Habakkuk — The Righteous Live by Faith
tagline: Why, LORD? — then watch and wait.
audience: Judah bewildered by God’s instruments of judgment.
purpose: Move from complaint to faith-filled worship.
christ: Hab 2:4 → Romans 1:17; Gal 3:11; Heb 10:38 — justification by faith.
spirit: Strength to walk on high places when fields fail.
jesus_in_this_book: Hab 2:4 → Romans 1:17; Gal 3:11; Heb 10:38 — justification by faith.
how_to_read: Take your why to the watchpost, not to unbelief.
watchman_charge: Stand your watch. Write the vision. Live by faith when the fig tree is bare.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
